metadata.name: Synthetic San Antonio to Austin low-start-fuel trip
metadata.source: Procedurally generated by scripts/generate-demo.mjs; no real vehicle or external dataset
metadata.route: Synthetic corridor: San Antonio, New Braunfels, San Marcos, Kyle, Austin, Texas
limitations: Approximate authored corridor polyline, not verified road geometry; interpolated positions may be off-road.
Starts at 17% fuel; naturally drops below 10%. No accelerated fuel depletion.
Speed is an interval-endpoint sample; fuel consumption uses trapezoidal speed and ending-record MPG.
All measurements and P0301 events are simulated. No diagnostic interpretation.
